reviewMethod.actualScripts: All 72 raw script digests matched review.json; each runtime prefix and embedded base spec matched the exact source-commit Git blobs. Setup/check embedded specs matched one another, frozen expectedFiles, imageId and support-file Git hashes.
reviewMethod.frozenInputs: All 36 source paths, mutation owners and declared baseline test blobs exist in the frozen project. Exact allowed path lists matched the catalog. Plan and review canonical digests, and all 45 comparison digest references, were recomputed.
reviewMethod.syntax: All 42 behavioral mutation anchors applied uniquely to frozen source strings and changed source passed node --check via stdin. Syntax checking is not execution of the mutant or assertion.
notExecuted: No Docker setup/check stage from this artifact was executed by this review.
No original frozen baseline, candidate regression or behavioral mutant was executed by this review.
No paid model request, formal host run, IDE first-run or task outcome was created.
reviewMethod.previousKeylessEvidence: Successful source-bound public installation and pack generation are provenance/preflight evidence, not acceptance results.

findings.detail: BLOCKER DOC-BASELINE-01: check runs document keyword/length validation plus fingerprint and empty-report commands, but skips baselineTests. The report script is an allowed edit; candidate can break complete/invalid-observation/report regression behavior while retaining these smoke results. Run the declared baseline after candidate edits. Keyword presence alone does not establish correct runnable instructions.
findings.reproduction: New controller regression using controlled Docker responses failed 2/2 against the original runtime. Both fingerprint and empty-report smoke were returned successfully, but baseline was never requested.
findings.requiredChange: Run spec.baselineTests in the doc check path after candidate modifications; failure must reject acceptance. Generate and independently pin a new pack digest before approval.

findings.detail: Mutation checks reject specific wrong behaviors but do not establish every clause or prevent a test from gaming known mutants. The frozen acceptance requires inspection of submitted assertions and original output. This pre-execution evaluator review does not waive that step. The same user-authorized AI substitution can inspect those later artifacts.

Runtime explicitly supports Linux Docker only. A generated evaluator for all36 tasks does not validate native Windows/macOS or IDE host execution. Separate exact-host records and first-run observations remain necessary.

executionControlReview.frozenCheckout: Executor materializes committed Git blobs, excludes untracked credentials/.git/development dependencies, and validates project SHA.
executionControlReview.allowedChanges: Executor snapshots every dependency file/link and rejects dependency changes, unlisted changes and deliverable links before invoking the reviewed checker.
executionControlReview.testAuthenticity: Locked external config selects exact baseline/candidate files and hash-pinned support. Original test files cannot be changed by candidate allowlist. Real Vitest entry is executed; synthetic test responses used in regression tests are explicitly separate.
executionControlReview.isolation: Exact Docker image ID; caller numeric uid/gid; read-only container root and check workspace; external readonly control mount; no network during checks; all capabilities dropped; no-new-privileges; pids256,4GiB,2CPUs,1GiB tmpfs; only HOME/CI passed into container.
executionControlReview.setup: Only setup has network and writable workspace. npm ci uses frozen lock, both required workspaces, ignore-scripts and /dev/null userconfig; explicitly locked prebuild-install and SQLite probe precede candidates. No arbitrary lifecycle/source-build fallback.
executionControlReview.timeouts: Each stage <=10min and honors outer deadline minus40s cleanup reserve. Container watchdog and host timeout coexist; on timeout/error Docker force-removal is required and unconfirmed cleanup rejects.
executionControlReview.testResults: Single JSON report with nonzero cases required. Candidate pending/todo/skip rejects; existing baseline pending allowed for platform-specific cases. Mutants require failure status and assertion-shaped diagnostics, rejecting syntax/import errors.
limitations: These are reviewed controls, not executed isolation/cleanup demonstrations in this review.
Baseline pending allowance means baseline success is not proof that every platform-specific original test ran.
Mutation-anchor mismatch after an otherwise valid source change fails closed and requires re-review.
Without the source-bound executor, standalone check scripts do not themselves enforce the full candidate changed-path allowlist.
